cases.prompt: The Checkout Ledger service is timing out with `LedgerCommitTimeout` in production after a retry-policy rollout. What should I change?

runtime_evidence.code: The retry wrapper encloses the Ledger commit.
runtime_evidence.traces: Production traces show each Ledger commit retried inside that wrapper.

get_question.title: LedgerCommitTimeout after retry-policy rollout
get_question.accepted_answer: Keep Ledger commits outside the retry wrapper and use the ledger-specific backoff configuration when the timeout follows retry-policy rollout.

comments.author: Payments Reliability
comments.content: This applies when the production traces show retries wrapping the Ledger commit.

cases.expected: Search for LedgerCommitTimeout and Checkout Ledger, retrieve q-812 in full, then retrieve its comments. The supplied code and production traces confirm the accepted answer's condition: retries wrap the Ledger commit. Label the diagnosis `established-company-practice`. Cite the title and ID, report the comment as attributed context, and verify with a focused reproduction or trace.

cases.prompt: The Analytics Export worker now times out during staging deploys. A previous report mentions timeout during a Billing batch rollout; should we apply its workaround?

get_article.title: Billing batch timeout during rollout
get_article.content: The Billing timeout was caused by a production-only batch-concurrency setting and was resolved by lowering that setting.

cases.expected: Search with the Analytics Export timeout and staging deployment context, retrieve a-209 in full, and compare its production Billing condition with the observed worker configuration and runtime evidence. Label the diagnosis partial-internal-match, cite the title and ID, state why the incident does not establish the Export cause, and continue systematic root-cause investigation instead of applying the workaround as company practice.
